In A Few Seconds
hero.description: Generate hull forms tailored to your requirements in seconds, complete with AI-predicted flow field information.

capabilities.label: 01 — Capabilities
capabilities.title: From a Few Numbers to an Efficient 3D Hull
capabilities.description: From first intent to validated performance, MarinAX brings generative design, AI prediction, proven engineering tools, and expert guidance into one continuous hull-form workflow.
capabilities.image_alt: MarinAX project workspace showing a selected vessel, principal design parameters, a fair 3D hull surface, and key performance results together in one clean overview

generate.title: Generate Hull Forms
generate.description: Enter only a few principal parameters. MarinAX recommends the rest, translates your design intent through generative AI, and delivers a fair, performance-ready 3D hull form in under 20 seconds.
generate.image_alt: MarinAX generative-design screen with a compact principal-parameter panel on the left and a newly generated, smooth commercial-vessel hull displayed in the interactive 3D viewport on the right
generate.caption: GENERATE / ITERATE / SELECT

prediction.title:
Predict the Flow
in a Few Seconds
prediction.description: Evaluate any user-supplied or AI-generated hull at near-CFD fidelity. MarinAX predicts surface pressure, wall shear stress, and the complete wake distribution in under 30 seconds, then reveals every result in interactive 3D.
prediction.image_alt: MarinAX AI prediction viewer showing a hull colored by surface-pressure contours alongside a three-dimensional stern wake plane with velocity-deficit contours and selectable pressure, shear-stress, and wake result layers
prediction.caption: PRESSURE / SHEAR / WAKE

integration.title:
One Integrated
Design Workflow
integration.description: Move seamlessly from generative AI and surrogate prediction to 2D lines, statistical performance estimates, hull-form modification, design alternatives, and high-fidelity CFD. MarinAX connects every tool and result in one environment built for hull-form optimization.
integration.image_alt: A MarinAX project workflow showing connected stages for AI hull generation, 2D lines, statistical prediction, hull modification, design alternatives, AI surrogate analysis, CFD validation, and side-by-side optimization results
integration.caption: DESIGN / PREDICT / VALIDATE

agent.title:
Ask Agent MAX
Everything
agent.description: Design by conversation with MAX, an engineering agent carefully harnessed with the judgment of a hull-form specialist with 40 years of experience. Describe your goal and MAX orchestrates generation, prediction, comparison, and optimization across MarinAX for you.
agent.prompt: “Generate three efficient hull forms, predict their wake fields, and recommend the best candidate.”
agent.image_alt: MarinAX conversational workspace with MAX responding to a natural-language design request while generated hull candidates, predicted performance metrics, and a recommended design appear in the adjacent engineering canvas
agent.caption: ASK / REASON / EXECUTE
